hooks.logic:
Count up "turnInCurrState".
If the count "turnInCurrState" is at least 5, then
  If a move is already queued, then stop.
  If the acting enemy is ready to act, then choose state 15 next.
Otherwise, call helper with (this state).

yes.text: the acting enemy is ready to act

hooks.logic:
Given arg.
Reset the count "turnInCurrState".
Call arg.

script_hooks.logic:
Given arg.
Let executer be the acting enemy of arg.
If executer is ready to act, then
  Let list be [].
  Append (the id of the move labelled "hakougeki" on executer) to list.
  Append (the id of the move labelled "kyougiri" on executer) to list.
  Append (the id of the move labelled "braver" on executer) to list.
  Let ability be a weighted random move of executer.
  If list contains ability, then executer uses ability with its cast time and then [{abilityId: the built-in move DEFORM_MULTI, abilityOptions: {sequence: [[{builtin: "SET_SA", sa: the INVISIBLE status}]]}}, {abilityId: ability}, {abilityId: the built-in move DEFORM_MULTI, abilityOptions: {sequence: [[{builtin: "UNSET_SA", sa: the INVISIBLE status}]]}}].
  Otherwise, executer uses ability.
